description: Lays out CS 454 notional lanes, remaining areas, footways and strips on a carriageway cross-section with the CS454 - Moving Load Wizard's own layout engine (Table 5.9a, cl 5.10, ALL model 1 single/convoy, ALL model 2, SV/HB routes and SV/HB with ALL), and lists the case groups each loading needs. Needs no model — use it to answer layout questions or to choose inputs before cs454_moving_loads.

lanes.description: Lane options. picked — Loadings to lay out: M1S (ALL model 1 single), M1C (convoy), M2 (ALL model 2), FW (footway), ACC (accidental), SV / HB (routes alone), SVM1S / SVM1C / SVM2 (SV with ALL), HBM1S / HBM1C / HBM2 (HB with ALL). Also level, packing, svVehicle, svPlacement, svStraddle, actualLanes, prefix…

section.description: Cross-section, m: width (carriageway), kerbOffset, markedLanes, hardShoulder, leftVerge, rightVerge, footways (leftFootway, rightFootway), central reserve.

name: cs454_lane_layout
title: CS 454 notional lanes for a carriageway
